_readme: The cases both Claude vision External tests run: tests/test_claude_vision_external.py (Python, surface anthropic-python) and workers/scan-proxy/src/external/anthropic.external.test.ts (the Worker, surface anthropic). One case per doc type, so each side makes one paid call per doc type and both look at the same photo. 'image' is a file name in ExampleDocs/. 'golden' is the key of an entry in the 'photos' section of ExampleDocs/golden_fields.json, which holds the expected field values and the known_ocr_limitations; the expected values are not copied here, so they cannot drift. A mismatch on a field named in known_ocr_limitations is tolerated, any other mismatch fails. The free offline tests tests/test_vision_shared_fixtures.py and workers/scan-proxy/src/visionSharedFixtures.test.ts check that every case points at an image and a golden entry that exist, that every doc type has a case, and that both external tests still read this file.
